title: Record the prefix-mask basis
body:
## Summary
- The prefix masks `M_t = 2^(t+1) - 1` form a basis: every mask in dimensions 1 through 20 has exactly one subset whose XOR equals it.
- That subset is the set of positions where consecutive bits differ, taking the bit past the top as zero. Its size is `2 * (number of 1-runs)` minus one when the low bit is set. A lone low bit has one boundary; every other single bit has two. There are 2,097,150 masks.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
